create_vkittidataset: create a VKittiDataset instance for training or testing with custom data directory and split
build_vkittidataset_get_data: build a data batch from VKittiDataset by specifying sequence index and number of images per sequence
test_vkittidataset_init: test the VKittiDataset initialization with train split and default parameters
refactor_vkittidataset_get_data: refactor the VKittiDataset.get_data method to support custom aspect ratio and specific frame ids
